data.title: Mon3tr · 权限记录
data.description: 她对着屏幕核对记录表，发现日期填错一格，便请同事确认正确的修改步骤。
data.camera: 中景，记录表与终端同框
data.promptProse: In a secure, darkened server room aboard Rhodes Island illuminated by pulsating green terminal screens, Mon3tr sits upright at an illuminated console, scrolling through digital security access manifests. Crystalline bio-luminescent conduits pulse faintly along its dark carapace, with server racks, diagnostic cables, and high-tech command readouts framing its vigilant, mechanical focus.
